questionSnapshot.question: What is the name of the snowman that Elsa and Anna built as children in Frozen?

notes: Read all four options, full matching topic digests and cross-bank comparisons; checked wording, category, editorial difficulty and main-film scope. Challenged animated adult Olaf versus the inanimate childhood model. D23 explicitly links the sisters’ first snowman to the name Olaf. Marshmallow is a different creation; Frosty and Snowflake are not this childhood snowman’s name.
